description: More Armor Kits: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, I must thank you for all your help. I have plenty of supplies, through no small efforts on your part, but if you wish to bring me more armor kits, then I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you are, friend. A fair trade. Enjoy.
